items.text: Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. Cincinnati: QUESTIONABLE last week - LB Oren Burks (groin), G Dalton Risner (knee). OUT - S Kyle Dugger, OT Myles Hinton (illness). IR - WR Andrei Iosivas, TE Erick All Jr. (season). Joe Burrow starts.

Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. Washington: IR - DT Daron Payne (season), WR Terry McLaurin (season), OT Laremy Tunsil, LB Leo Chenal, RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt (designated to return). Jayden Daniels starts.
